meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here before anyone called me?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says never to use it as the only basis for punishing a student, so what else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale, because that's what this sounds like. You have a score from software and an accusation, so show me one document.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

Put it on his record before showing me a single document? Under which section, and who decided that, when nobody has spoken to me or to Owen first. I'll want that in writing, and I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing is or will be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a promise that nothing goes on his record, which is not the fair outcome, since that is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no document she could check, only a score and an accusation.
What cost ground: You threatened to put it on his permanent record before showing any evidence, which hit the one thing she never trades and sent her to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you offered none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Instead of opening with the detector score, start by owning that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put one dated document in front of her that she can check herself.
